title: Server Folders
description: A tiny client side mod, that allows you to organize your server list. :)
body:
This client-side mod allows you to organize and manage your Multiplayer Servers more efficiently. 

With a cleaner and more customizable server list, you can sort, group, and keep track of your favorite servers with ease,

making it much simpler to navigate and enjoy multiplayer gameplay. 

:)

more features and bug fixes soon!

-Nox
